cards.quote: In a stunning turn of events, former Prairie View college basketball standout Wesley Afolayan has traded in his sneakers for skates, making a successful transition to the National Hockey League (NHL). The 28-year-old Afolayan, who played for Prairie View from 2013 to 2015, has become the first player in history to make the jump from college basketball to the NHL. Afolayan's remarkable journey began just over a year ago, when he started taking hockey lessons at a local rink in Houston, Texas. What started as a hobby quickly turned into an obsession, with Afolayan dedicating countless hours to honing his skills on the ice. "I always loved the speed and physicality of hockey," Afolayan said in an exclusive interview with our publication. "I never thought I'd be good enough to play at this level, but I'm living proof that with hard work and determination, anything is possible." Fast forward to today, and Afolayan is now a key contributor for the NHL's Vegas Golden Knights, notching 5 goals and 3 assists in his first 10 games.
